title: 卡西奥佩娅·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 绿金鳞片覆盖修长蛇身，深发衬着眼镜蛇意象的金色冠饰。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Cassiopeia is an adult woman with a long continuous serpentine lower body, green-gold scales, an ornate cobra-inspired golden crown, and long dark hair. Preserve her expressive humanlike face and unmistakable snake anatomy without human legs. An opaque high-neck long-sleeved emerald tunic fully covers the upper body, while her coiled tail rests naturally and her closed mouth shows no threatening fangs.
art_direction.scene: A slightly elevated complete figure, asymmetric curved silhouette, naturally separated hands and a small sunlit ground cue. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: emerald, gold, teal, pale sandstone; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
